caption: The drawing features a single object that appears to be a combination of a brown leather strap, a round metallic disc, and a metallic spur with a rowel (the spiked wheel at the end). The leather section is brown with visible stitching and shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The metallic disc is circular, yellowish-gold in color, and attached to the leather section. The spur is dark-colored with some silver or gray decorative accents and ends in a star-shaped rowel that is metallic gray. The objects are set against an off-white or cream background, and there are no additional elements in the composition. The orientation of the objects is diagonal, with the rowel facing lower left and the leather section positioned at the upper right.
title: Spur
